summary: At a populated model world, well-founded causal predecessors yield an actual existent with no incoming cause from another actual existent; existence-PSR adds a stipulated reason for its existence fact. Removing causal well-foundedness permits a mutually-causing pair satisfying PSR and universal external causation; removing population makes universal predicates vacuous. Explicitly non-divine and non-modal conclusion; adequacy of explanatory reasons unestablished. See docs/causal-finite-branching-and-psr-syllogisms.md.
